content: 11:1-16 Tari im bugamanimau end Pol qamarei
Ye Munon inubersiau tari eng mom wapet qib igoum gas ende an bo ye yewapet qib igoarar.
An yet mom igub ne ye qob igub aninob qamb igoum eng mom toat igoumon, ende igub mismisiraum. Eng qomon sig uber at igoumon.

Ego an ete misir igar qamb misir igoum: Munon gugum wurinou baraitari eng Munon inubersiau tari eng. Ne yamangar wurinou baraitari eng wurinou umumiagarar. Ne Munon inubersiau tari eng wonou baraitari eng Qenu.
End munon ger Qenut qebi qamb qiyo, a wonou qob dibes munon qei wurinob qamb ne tari metei igo qemeriner eng wonou baraitari eng qininingiba.

Ne gor yamangar ger Qenut qebi qamb qiyo, a wonou qob munon mag qurt qemerib eng tari me meteiminer eng gor wonou umami wot qininingiba. Eng yamangar ger tari im me meteiminer eng wonou tari im gugum wabur arir qinining igo gas ende gari.
End yamangar tari im me meteimb eng tari im soopurma piten buriner. A piten me soopur qiyo a gugum waburmau end qinininginer qamb tari suumieminer.
Munon wonou tari me suumieminer. Qenu wonou qiribiten eng wot igo. Ne yamangar wo munon wonou git baab igo gas ende.
Qenu yamangar git goan eng ba munon me barsiau, ue, munon git goan eng ba yamangar barsiarei.
Ne gor Qenu yamangart igub munon barsine nob igoar qamb me barsiau. Munont igub yamangar barsine nob igoar qamb barsiarei.
End ne munon yamangar wonou baraitari igo end ne wonou tari im eng suumi igama ne enger wuri ibag imbigubour.
End in gugum Munon Aib wonou, end yamangar igamari munon ue qiyo munon igamari yamangar ue qiyo ende ue.
Munon git goan end yamangar barsiarei. End see yamangar wurit munon misinam der isub igour.
Aninou qob eng qerei imbigar. Yamangar ger mag diban Qenut igub qebi qemerib qamb eng tari me meteiminer eng uber qiyo?
Git apand, ininou munangit qomon eng ende: Munon ger tari im degen isiner eng uber ue.
Yamangar wurinou tari im degen ende igoriner eng uber. Qenu wonou tari im degen ende aba diab tari qer eng moni igoar qamb.
Ego munon ger wonou mi end qomon ger bigib eng ende ebet igoriner. Ego in Qenu yurau wot qebi qomorub eng qomon ger end me igo.
11:17-22 Munon Aib git goan uter war eng
Qomon eng ebet igoumon end ye qen me animbiginei. Ye qomon ger ete qemerine igar: aninou qiumuni igoumon end qomon uber ger me ebet igoumon, qomon boru qas ebet igoumon.
Qenut igub qamb qiumuni eng an purab tau-tau isub igoumon. Eng qamarari igub ye apand an ende ebet igoumon qamb quraum.
End ne munon qei qomon abari an ibagaumon eng qomon uber ue gab eng an end wuri gitatar an purab tau-tau isunon eng uber. Munon qob uber qamarari igub eng an wurinob qiumuni igoarar.
Qen end an gugum qiumuni Munon Aib mani eng an me nub igoumon.
Eng an qei qand der aninou mani wes-wes eng ba nub igoumon. Ende abari qei ar igo minemb igour. Qei ar igamari an qei ya uter nub qanganget igoumon.

End ne mai, aninou munai mor end igo ya mani qamb nunon eng ue qiyo? An mai, Qenu yurau eng mi ar gas ende ibag wagari wuri minemb qinining qib igour qiyo? Ye mai aninob qemeribam? Ye an qomon ende abari animbag mismisiribam qiyo? Sig ue ar. Ye im animbag me quraum, song aninob quraum.
11:23-26 Munon Aib mani parau wain ya nob wonou imbigau yurau wuriserei

Ye qob eng aninob quraum eng yonou misirt me quraum. Munon Aib wonou qob ete igo eng toat quraum: itum end Yudas ininou Munon Aib Yisas munon qarau wurit duiamorei. Ende aba itum end Yisas mani parau ba,
Qenut qebi qamb boroumi werisib qamb qamar: “mani e yonou min nob morogot igo. An ba nub nonoguretoruboumon. An ende at igo yet qenen igub igoarar.”
Eng ende at wogub bo wain ya qogum end wari wurisab qamar: “wain ya qogumt e yonou qeru nob morogot igo. Qenu wonou qob bubun anit nausiar eng. An qenen nub ne yet misir igub igoarar.”
Qenen an mani parau ya qogumt eng nob nub Munon Aib umor end dibes qamb igoumon. Ende at ten igamari Munon Aib deriner.
11:27-34 Ininou misir musub qerei ne Munon Aib mani nun

End munon ger wonou qomon boru end misir me igub song ar Munon Aib wonou mani parau nob wonou qeru qogumt wariamor eng nob niner eng, wo Munon Aib wonou min qeru nob ba sumungasi igo. Qen geret munon eng wonomit imiamor end qubuagiba.
End munon ger mani parau ne ya qogumt igo eng nib qamb eng mom musub imbig ne niner.
Munon Aib min qeru nob end me igub wonou mi ar niau gas ende ebeiner eng wonomi dui ebeiba.
Qanam end ne an munon irou qer uburab toar aningara ne qei umb uburamanei.
In mom musub imbig nun eng Qenu insiningoar me inwanunginerei.
End Munon Aib ininou qomon boru eng gab inquguragsi igo. Ende aba in wonou yurau igoarar qamb munon ai qent e wurinob sori umumar qamb.
Io, end ne an Munon Aib wonou mani eng nub qamb qiumuni gab eng qei me yarari gab eng oroar igoarar.

Munon ger minemb gab eng mor end mi niner. An qiumuni munon qei imiemet abari an gugum qomon biisitet aninou bo mit imimunon qamb. Ye qob eng gumaum eng tau igo, qen geret bo anit yarab musub qemerine igar.
